'''Grakchawwaa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who served as [[King/Legends|King]] and ruled on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wrrhwrwwhw uughghhhgh uuh huuguughghg, raaaaaahhgh uughghhhgh huuguughghg. Aguhwwgggghhh uughguughhhghghghhhgh wrrhw.|Grakchawwaa, in response to criticism that the Royal Families are not adequately protecting Kashyyyk's moons|<ref name="War on Wookiee World">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.49|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.49]]</ref>}}
[[File:Grakchawwaa-DaG.png|thumb|left|150px|Grakchawwaa wearing his bandoleer]]
Grakchawwaa was the dominant figure and deciding voice on the council that met in the [[Kashyyyk Royal City/Legends|Royal City]] at the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="DF" /> but while he was apparently the most important ruler on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], he represented only one of several [[Kashyyyk Royal Families]], and the exact parameters of his preeminence are unclear from surviving evidence.

Despite being courted by both the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Grakchawwaa initially opted to maintain a course of neutrality for the Wookiees. However, when [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] sent by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] killed his son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Rikummee]], he decided to join with the Republic.<ref name="DF" /> He was challenged by [[Quaagan]], who aided the Confederate commander [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Grakchawwaa may have enlisted the aid of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to hunt down the traitor.
